methods.formula: Stage-weighted value = Σ weight × central value of the stage's methods (weights renormalized over the methods available)

assumptions: fixed by stage before any result was seen (base_rates.STAGES)

methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $14.50B (to $31.02B) × margin 13.1% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $31.33B
K = capital to build it: $14.50B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.44 = $32.84B
σ = 25% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $9.48B
assets in place = NOPAT $2.08B ÷ WACC = $33.63B; value = ($33.63B + $9.48B − net debt $25.07B) ÷ 208,000,000 = $86.72

methods.formula: Value = D₀ × [(1 + g_L) + H × (g_S − g_L)] ÷ (kₑ − g_L);  growth falls in a straight line from g_S to g_L over 2H years
